description.zh:
事件范围，取值：

- `INSTANCE`：实例

- `NAMESPACE`：命名空间

- `REPO`：镜像仓库

默认值：`INSTANCE`
description.en:
The event scope. Valid values:

*   `INSTANCE`
*   `NAMESPACE`
*   `REPO`

Default value: `INSTANCE`

description.zh:
事件类型，取值：
- `cr:Artifact:DeliveryChainCompleted`：交付链处理完成
- `cr:Artifact:SynchronizationCompleted`：镜像同步完成
- `cr:Artifact:BuildCompleted`：镜像构建完成
- `cr:Artifact:ScanCompleted`：镜像扫描完成
- `cr:Artifact:SigningCompleted`：镜像加签完成
description.en:
The type of the event. Valid values:

*   `cr:Artifact:DeliveryChainCompleted`: The delivery chain is processed.
*   `cr:Artifact:SynchronizationCompleted`: The image is replicated.
*   `cr:Artifact:BuildCompleted`: The image is built.
*   `cr:Artifact:ScanCompleted`: The image is scanned.
*   `cr:Artifact:SigningCompleted`: The image is signed.

description.zh: 事件规则生效的命名空间
description.en: The namespaces to which the event notification rule applies.

description.zh: 事件规则生效的仓库名称
description.en: The names of the repositories to which the event notification rule applies.
The regular expression for image tags.
The ID of the event notification rule.
The name of the event notification rule.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr update-event-center-rule --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --rule-id crecr-n6pbhgjxt00000 --rule-name chain-demo --event-channel EVENT_BRIDGE --event-type cr:Artifact:DeliveryChainCompleted --event-scope INSTANCE --namespaces ns1 --repo-names repo1 --repo-tag-filter-pattern .0 --event-config notifyMethod_:_http_,_notifyConfig_:_Url_:_http://www.aliyundoc.com_,_id_:_MaAV3HgTkO5Fh8l1V00000000_,_,_notifyFilter_: --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr UpdateEventCenterRule --region cn-hangzhou --EventChannel EVENT_BRIDGE --RepoTagFilterPattern '.0' --Namespaces '["ns1"]' --InstanceId 'cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000' --EventType 'cr:Artifact:DeliveryChainCompleted' --RuleId 'crecr-n6pbhgjxt00000' --EventScope INSTANCE --RepoNames '["repo1"]' --EventConfig 'notifyMethod_:_http_,_notifyConfig_:_Url_:_http://www.aliyundoc.com_,_id_:_MaAV3HgTkO5Fh8l1V00000000_,_,_notifyFilter_:' --RuleName 'chain-demo'
